newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Queensland appoints new Suncorp chairman.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Queensland appoints new Suncorp chairman.

text.p: The Queensland Government said on Monday that Martin Kriewaldt had replaced Graham Tucker as chairman of its Suncorp Insurance and Finance subsidiary.
State deputy premier and treasurer Joan Sheldon said that Tucker had resigned.

She said the appointment of Kreiwaldt, a partner in national law firm Allen Allen and Hemsley, "represented a changing of the guard as Suncorp prepares to enter its historic merger with Metway Bank and the Queensland Industry Development Corp" (QIDC).

Kriewaldt is a member of the state government's merger planning group which will become the new board of the bancassurance group when it begins operations by the end of 1996. "Mr Kriewaldt was the natural choice to succeed Mr Tucker who had performed capably as chairman over the last six years," Sheldon said.

Suncorp earlier said 1995/96 net profit rose to A$201.1 million from A$101.1 million. The latest result included a A$125 million pre-tax insurance gain. It said 1996/97 earnings should be lower due to falling investment returns, margins, and housing market share. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
